header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes with every timeout
counted: the launcher, Load ROM on a new profile once the page has its shader list (Chrome builds the whole list
behind the launcher, and says when it is done; Firefox builds none there, and says so as the launcher comes up), Play
(pressed until the game has booted), the logos and the title. tools/shader_survey.js's play(), a need, then loads File
1 from the file select as a player does (making it on a new profile, its opening cutscene cleared), Link runs about
his house, and the pause menu's four pages are turned there. A picture is taken of the title and of the house.
tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to three more places by the survey's warp(), for when a longer play is needed.

start: (() => { try { n64r(0x80000000); return true; } catch { return false; } })()
play: (() => { window.planWaits = {}; window.later = (label, p) => { window.planWaits[label] = p; const say = (text) => setTimeout(() => console.log('[plan] ' + label + ': ' + text), 1000); p.then((v) => say(JSON.stringify(v)), (e) => say(String(e))); return label + ' started'; }; return 'later()'; })()
